رَبَذَةٌ : see the next preceding paragraph, in two places. ―
-b2- Also The عَذَبَة [app. as meaning the عِلَاقَة, or suspensory thong in the handle,] of a whip: (K:) [n. un. of ↓ رَبَذٌ : for you say] سَوْطٌ ذُو رَبَذٍ meaning A whip having thongs in the fore part of its جَلْز [or handle]. (En-Nadr, TA.) ＝
-A2- Also Difficulty, or distress. (IAar, T, K.) So in the saying, كُنَّا فِى رَبَذَةٍ فَٱنْجَلَتْ عَنَّا [We were in difficulty, or distress, and it became removed, or cleared away, from us]. (IAar, T.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
